tools.name: get_windows_and_tabs
tools.description: Get all currently open browser windows and tabs

tools.name: chrome_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a URL or refresh the current tab

url.description: URL to navigate to the website specified

newWindow.description: Create a new window to navigate to the URL or not. Defaults to false

refresh.description: Refresh the current active tab instead of navigating to a URL. When true, the url parameter is ignored. Defaults to false

tools.name: chrome_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page or a specific element(if you want to see the page, recommend to use chrome_get_web_content first)

name.description: Name for the screenshot, if saving as PNG

selector.description: CSS selector for element to screenshot

storeBase64.description: return screenshot in base64 format (default: false) if you want to see the page, recommend set this to be true

fullPage.description: Store screenshot of the entire page (default: true)

savePng.description: Save screenshot as PNG file (default: true)，if you want to see the page, recommend set this to be false, and set storeBase64 to be true

tools.name: chrome_close_tabs
tools.description: Close one or more browser tabs

tabIds.description: Array of tab IDs to close. If not provided, will close the active tab.

url.description: Close tabs matching this URL. Can be used instead of tabIds.

tools.name: chrome_go_back_or_forward
tools.description: Navigate back or forward in browser history

isForward.description: Go forward in history if true, go back if false (default: false)

tools.name: chrome_get_web_content
tools.description: Fetch content from a web page

url.description: URL to fetch content from. If not provided, uses the current active tab

htmlContent.description: Get the visible HTML content of the page. If true, textContent will be ignored (default: false)

textContent.description: Get the visible text content of the page with metadata. Ignored if htmlContent is true (default: true)

selector.description: CSS selector to get content from a specific element. If provided, only content from this element will be returned

tools.name: chrome_click_element
tools.description: Click on an element in the current page or at specific coordinates

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to click. Either selector or coordinates must be provided. if coordinates are not provided, the selector must be provided.

coordinates.description: Coordinates to click at (relative to viewport). If provided, takes precedence over selector.

x.description: X coordinate relative to the viewport

y.description: Y coordinate relative to the viewport

waitForNavigation.description: Wait for page navigation to complete after click (default: false)

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for waiting for the element or navigation (default: 5000)

tools.name: chrome_fill_or_select
tools.description: Fill a form element or select an option with the specified value

selector.description: CSS selector for the input element to fill or select

value.description: Value to fill or select into the element

tools.name: chrome_get_interactive_elements
tools.description: Get interactive elements from the current page

textQuery.description: Text to search for within interactive elements (fuzzy search)

selector.description: CSS selector to filter interactive elements. Takes precedence over textQuery if both are provided.

includeCoordinates.description: Include element coordinates in the response (default: true)

tools.name: chrome_network_request
tools.description: Send a network request from the browser with cookies and other browser context

url.description: URL to send the request to

headers.description: Headers to include in the request

body.description: Body of the request (for POST, PUT, etc.)

tools.name: chrome_network_debugger_start
tools.description: Start capturing network requests from a web page using Chrome Debugger API（with responseBody）

url.description: URL to capture network requests from. If not provided, uses the current active tab

tools.name: chrome_network_debugger_stop
tools.description: Stop capturing network requests using Chrome Debugger API and return the captured data

tools.name: chrome_network_capture_start
tools.description: Start capturing network requests from a web page using Chrome webRequest API(without responseBody)

url.description: URL to capture network requests from. If not provided, uses the current active tab

tools.name: chrome_network_capture_stop
tools.description: Stop capturing network requests using webRequest API and return the captured data

tools.name: chrome_keyboard
tools.description: Simulate keyboard events in the browser

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to send keyboard events to (optional, defaults to active element)

delay.description: Delay between key sequences in milliseconds (optional, default: 0)

tools.name: chrome_history
tools.description: Retrieve and search browsing history from Chrome

text.description: Text to search for in history URLs and titles. Leave empty to retrieve all history entries within the time range.

startTime.description: Start time as a date string. Supports ISO format (e.g., "2023-10-01", "2023-10-01T14:30:00"), relative times (e.g., "1 day ago", "2 weeks ago", "3 months ago", "1 year ago"), and special keywords ("now", "today", "yesterday"). Default: 24 hours ago

endTime.description: End time as a date string. Supports ISO format (e.g., "2023-10-31", "2023-10-31T14:30:00"), relative times (e.g., "1 day ago", "2 weeks ago", "3 months ago", "1 year ago"), and special keywords ("now", "today", "yesterday"). Default: current time

maxResults.description: Maximum number of history entries to return. Use this to limit results for performance or to focus on the most relevant entries. (default: 100)

excludeCurrentTabs.description: When set to true, filters out URLs that are currently open in any browser tab. Useful for finding pages you've visited but don't have open anymore. (default: false)

tools.name: chrome_bookmark_search
tools.description: Search Chrome bookmarks by title and URL

query.description: Search query to match against bookmark titles and URLs. Leave empty to retrieve all bookmarks.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of bookmarks to return (default: 50)

folderPath.description: Optional folder path or ID to limit search to a specific bookmark folder. Can be a path string (e.g., "Work/Projects") or a folder ID.

tools.name: chrome_bookmark_add
tools.description: Add a new bookmark to Chrome

url.description: URL to bookmark. If not provided, uses the current active tab URL.

title.description: Title for the bookmark. If not provided, uses the page title from the URL.

parentId.description: Parent folder path or ID to add the bookmark to. Can be a path string (e.g., "Work/Projects") or a folder ID. If not provided, adds to the "Bookmarks Bar" folder.

createFolder.description: Whether to create the parent folder if it does not exist (default: false)

tools.name: chrome_bookmark_delete
tools.description: Delete a bookmark from Chrome

bookmarkId.description: ID of the bookmark to delete. Either bookmarkId or url must be provided.

url.description: URL of the bookmark to delete. Used if bookmarkId is not provided.

title.description: Title of the bookmark to help with matching when deleting by URL.

tools.name: search_tabs_content
tools.description: search for related content from the currently open tab and return the corresponding web pages.

query.description: the query to search for related content.

tools.name: chrome_inject_script
tools.description: inject the user-specified content script into the webpage. By default, inject into the currently active tab

url.description: If a URL is specified, inject the script into the webpage corresponding to the URL.

type.description: the javaScript world for a script to execute within. must be ISOLATED or MAIN

tools.name: chrome_send_command_to_inject_script
tools.description: if the script injected using chrome_inject_script listens for user-defined events, this tool can be used to trigger those events

tabId.description: the tab where you previously injected the script(if not provided,  use the currently active tab)

eventName.description: the eventName your injected content script listen for

payload.description: the payload passed to event, must be a json string

tools.name: chrome_console
tools.description: Capture and retrieve all console output from the current active browser tab/page. This captures console messages that existed before the tool was called.

url.description: URL to navigate to and capture console from. If not provided, uses the current active tab

includeExceptions.description: Include uncaught exceptions in the output (default: true)

maxMessages.description: Maximum number of console messages to capture (default: 100)
